verdict.rationale: Capacities lists "Smart queries" as a feature, and its docs refer to queries, collections and object type dashboards that can be opened as graphs, on top of typed objects with properties. Nothing in the pack shows how those queries filter by properties or that results render as live table, board or list views. missing for 10: documentation of property-based query filters, documented live table/board/list views of query results, hands-on or independent corroboration

support.subject: As a power-user, I can query my notes by their structured properties and render live database-style views (tables, boards, lists) from those queries

citations.quote: You can also open a graph on a collection, a tag, a query, an object type dashboard, or in extended search.
Define key object types early (`People`, `Projects`, `Meetings`, etc.) and add core properties.
